first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The tall, slim man with a crew cut in the image-left foreground, wearing a dark zip-up jacket and dark trousers.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: The man in the image-right foreground, wearing a dark close-fitting cap, a loose dark leather jacket, a light-colored turtleneck top, and light-colored trousers.

entities.name: Person D
entities.identification: Person D: the person who crossed the extreme foreground from image-left to image-right in the preceding segment. In frame 0 of this segment, only a tiny portion of a dark coat and a light-colored hem edge remains visible at the extreme image-right edge; Person D then exits the frame.

entities.name: multistory buildings along the street
entities.identification: Continuous multistory buildings on both sides of the road and a distant central spire, with rows of windows, balconies, and pitched roofs.

entities.name: city road and intersection
entities.identification: The street converging toward the distance in the center and the partially visible transverse road at the near end.

entities.name: trees along the street
entities.identification: Broad areas of irregular dark gray tree crowns and visible branches on both sides of the street.

entities.name: overcast sky
entities.identification: The light gray sky above and in the gaps between the buildings, with soft, layered cloud patterns.

entities.name: cars on the road
entities.identification: Multiple low cars of varying light and dark tones on the road, treated as a background group and excluding Vehicle B.

entities.name: Vehicle B
entities.identification: The long-bodied bus in the lower background in frame 0, with its long light-colored roof, upper body, and dark side-window band visible.

entities.name: dark metal railing
entities.identification: The dark horizontal rail and spaced vertical posts extending across the image behind the people.

entities.name: stone parapet
entities.identification: The parapet extending horizontally below the railing, with a broad dark band on top and a mottled light gray wall surface below.

entities.name: pedestrians at the street intersection
entities.identification: Multiple small human-shaped silhouettes in the distant pedestrian area, treated as a background group.

entities.name: streetlights along the street
entities.identification: Slender upright poles with lamp heads at the top on both sides of the street.
